plan:
TrACT-inspired learning-process diagnosis (not a TrACT model reproduction)
Locked before running: 2026-10-29.
Source experiment: horizon_15_15_g1_20261029, unchanged 16 history / 15 future,
65 old +142 new windows, five recording folds and seeds17/29/43, both arms.
Reuse saved shared camera; reproduce30 person trainings from scratch with original
initialization, sampler, loss, optimizer,240 updates and validation selection.
No new labels, data selection, reweighting, prototype loss or baseline replacement.
Instrument every20 updates including0. Evaluate all eligible expanded TRAIN windows
and original validation windows. In original-only arm new windows are untrained
diagnostic probes, NOT validation data. No held-out test learning curves or map.
Fixed original five inference draws; instrumentation must preserve Torch RNG.
Save per-time errors, actual sampling counts, losses, all checkpoint states.
Verify original selected weights, validation logs, sample-draw hashes and test
replay; preserve original files with hashes. New checkpoints diagnostic only.
Primary map: final step240 residualADE vs variance over steps20..240, per fit.
Step0 excluded from primary variance; include0 and late120..240 sensitivity.
Four relative groups use median final error and variance within expanded training
pool of each fold/seed; reuse thresholds for paired original old-training map.
Thresholds descriptive, not paper numerical cutoffs or intrinsic quality labels.
Track all curves, last-quarter slope and rebound; variance alone has no time order.
Aggregate within fit first, with seed/fold summaries; overlapping windows and
repeated folds are not independent samples. Unique-window and recording-level
summaries supplementary. Only trained windows get learning-difficulty labels.
EDGC computed using16 historical frames (not original6): E OLS log box-height
slope/s; D median box-height/1920; G OLS rotation-stabilized y velocity/1920/s;
C RGB-camera path length / historical duration from saved translation features.
Use continuous EDGC, no reuse of old0.5s thresholds. Future suffix not used.
Inspect learning maps, old/new paired learning curves, EDGC associations and
representative training-only curves. Correlations are descriptive, not causation.
Reference: https://arxiv.org/html/2404.12538v2 (TrACT,2024), sectionsIII-C/D.
